company.name: Calltree AI
company.shortDescription: Calltree AI utilizes data-driven insights to optimize contact center operational costs.
company.description: Calltree AI, founded in 2025 and based in San Francisco, is a SaaS company that leverages generative AI to optimize contact center workflows. The company's AI agent analyzes millions of minutes of contact center recordings to identify inefficiencies in workflows and quantify the cost of each action. These insights are delivered through an analytics tool and reports that help operations leaders build business cases to prioritize improvements. Founders Kun Kian and Robertson Taylor lead the company.

productsAndServices.description: A data-driven solution that provides insights into contact center operational costs to help organizations optimize expenses and workflows.
productsAndServices.name: Calltree AI Contact Center Cost Optimization
